title: Detection and Validation of Hidden Subgroup Disparities in Clinical AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.32362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) models used in clinical workflows often perform systematically differently across patient groups, raising concerns about equity and patient safety. Traditional subgroup analyses can expose such disparities only when rich metadata (e.g., patient demographics) is available and captures the sources of performance variation, conditions rarely met in practice. Algorithmic subgroup discovery methods offer a solution by identifying coherent groups from learned feature representations, but because true underlying stratifications are unknown, these methods are hard to evaluate. As a result, subgroup discovery has not been systematically applied or assessed for performance monitoring. Our main objective is to evaluate algorithmic subgroup discovery for performance monitoring, assessing the discovered subgroups' performance gaps and semantic coherence. translated_title: 临床AI中隐藏亚组差异的检测与验证
translated_abstract: 用于临床工作流程的机器学习（ML）模型在不同患者群体中的表现往往存在系统性差异，这引发了对公平性和患者安全的担忧。传统的亚组分析只有在有丰富元数据（如患者人口统计学信息）可用且能捕捉性能差异来源时才能揭示此类差异，而这些条件在实践中很少得到满足。算法化亚组发现方法通过从学习到的特征表示中识别连贯的群体来提供了一种解决方案，但由于真实的潜在分层是未知的，这些方法难以评估。因此，亚组发现尚未被系统地应用于性能监测或对其进行评估。我们的主要目标是评估算法化亚组发现用于性能监测的效果，评估所发现亚组的性能差距和语义连贯性。我们在包含223,228张胸部X光片的数据集中研究了心脏肥大分类任务……
tldr: 该论文提出通过算法化亚组发现在缺乏丰富元数据的情况下检测临床AI模型中隐藏的患者亚组性能差异，并对所发现亚组的性能差距和语义连贯性进行了评估与验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and validates an algorithmic subgroup discovery approach to detect hidden subgroup performance disparities in clinical AI models without requiring rich metadata, evaluating both the performance gaps and semantic coherence of the discovered subgroups.
